subject.title: Bug: Telegram delivery queue recovery can replay old sendMessage replies and duplicate delivery-mirror transcript entries

question: How should recovery handle legacy Telegram delivery-queue rows that migrated without `recoveryState` but have an ambiguous `sendMessage` network failure?
rationale: The code can implement several narrow policies, but the correct default chooses between possible dropped unsent messages and possible duplicate delivered messages for existing users upgrading from shipped queue files.

options.title: Quarantine ambiguous legacy Telegram rows
options.body: Treat legacy unmarked Telegram rows with ambiguous network send errors as unsafe to replay, move or keep them out of blind recovery, and document/operator-surface the skipped delivery.

options.title: Infer `unknown_after_send` during migration
options.body: Migrate matching legacy Telegram rows into the existing marked unknown-send path so future reconciliation or no-blind-replay behavior handles them consistently.

options.title: Keep current replay behavior
options.body: Accept duplicate-send risk for legacy unmarked rows to avoid dropping any possibly unsent queued reply.

recommendation.title: Quarantine ambiguous legacy Telegram rows
recommendation.body: Treat legacy unmarked Telegram rows with ambiguous network send errors as unsafe to replay, move or keep them out of blind recovery, and document/operator-surface the skipped delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The current recovery/migration code is recently blamed to steipete and he merged the adjacent outbound recovery hardening PR, making him the best available owner for the upgrade-policy call.
